# Hyperallergic

> > Hyperallergic is an online arts magazine covering contemporary art, cultural politics, museum controversies, artist activism, and institutional critique with a focus on social justice and decolonization.

Founded as a critical voice in the art world, Hyperallergic reports on exhibitions, artist interviews, cultural heritage issues, and the intersection of art with politics. The publication covers major institutions like the Guggenheim Museum and Whitney Biennial while championing underrepresented voices and challenging power structures in the arts.

## Key Topics

- Contemporary Art
- Institutional Critique
- Cultural Heritage & Repatriation
- Artist Activism
- LGBTQ+ Photography & Queer History
- Nan Goldin
- Museum Politics
- Art Education
- Exhibition Reviews
- Gaza & Palestine
- Jeffrey Epstein Art World Connections
- AIDS Epidemic Documentation
- Decolonization
- Art Market & Class Issues
- Regional Art Scenes

## Art World News & Investigations

- [Jeff Koons Attended Dinner Party at Jeffrey Epstein's House](https://hyperallergic.com/jeff-koons-attended-dinner-party-at-jeffrey-epsteins-house): Jeff Koons confirms attending 2013 dinner at Epstein's home per DOJ docs
- [Art Critic Sebastian Smee Laid Off From the Washington Post](https://hyperallergic.com/art-critic-sebastian-smee-laid-off-from-the-washington-post): Pulitzer winner Sebastian Smee cut as Washington Post downsizes culture desk
- [School of Visual Arts Shutters Its Curatorial Practice MA Program](https://hyperallergic.com/school-of-visual-arts-shutters-its-curatorial-practice-ma-program): SVA closes 14-year-old Curatorial Practice MA program amid financial pressures
- [Did the British Museum Remove Palestine From Its Displays?](https://hyperallergic.com/did-the-british-museum-remove-palestine-from-its-displays): British Museum changes labels from Palestine to Canaan in Middle East galleries
- [Smithsonian to Return Three Looted Bronzes to Indian Government](https://hyperallergic.com/smithsonian-to-return-three-looted-bronzes-to-india): Smithsonian repatriates Hindu bronzes stolen from Tamil temples to India

## Artist Profiles & Interviews

- [All the Beauty and the Tenderness of Nan Goldin](https://hyperallergic.com/all-the-beauty-and-the-tenderness-of-nan-goldin): Interview with photographer Nan Goldin on activism and moving beyond photography
- [In Conversation: Will Wilson](https://hyperallergic.com/in-conversation-will-wilson): Diné photographer Will Wilson exhibition at Visual Arts Center of New Jersey
- [A View From the Easel](https://hyperallergic.com/a-view-from-the-easel-321): Artist Clara Cohan's Maine studio practice and wood sculpture workspace
- [Art Beyond the Coasts: Five West Virginia Artists to Know](https://hyperallergic.com/art-beyond-the-coasts-five-west-virginia-artists-to-know): Profiles of five contemporary artists from Appalachian West Virginia

## Exhibition Reviews & Announcements

- [Ana Mendieta's Injured Earth](https://hyperallergic.com/ana-mendieta-injured-earth): Review of Ana Mendieta: Fuego de Tierra exhibition on earth-body art
- [The Bukhara Biennial Will Break Your Heart](https://hyperallergic.com/the-bukhara-biennial-will-break-your-heart): Review of Uzbekistan's first major biennial in historic Bukhara
- ["Uman: After all the things …" On View at The Aldrich Contemporary Art Museum](https://hyperallergic.com/aldrich-contemporary-art-museum-presents-uman): Uman's first solo museum show at Aldrich in Connecticut with new works
- [Art and Power Collide in New York City](https://hyperallergic.com/art-and-power-collide-in-new-york-city): NYC exhibition guide covering Epstein scandal, Goya, and Amazonian artists

## Art & Activism

- [In Minneapolis, Artists Mobilize to Crush ICE](https://hyperallergic.com/in-minneapolis-artists-mobilize-to-crush-ice): Minneapolis artists create protest art against ICE presence in Minnesota
- [Why Are We Paying for the Privilege of Rejection?](https://hyperallergic.com/why-are-we-paying-for-the-privilege-of-rejection): Opinion on application fees as class stratification in the arts
